evals.prompt: Make an 8-second video that goes into the room in evals/files/bookshop.jpg and circles the display table once.
evals.expected_output: An MP4 that opens on the photo, moves in, and goes around the display table, with the table and its books keeping their shape.
assertions: The image was posed with images2PosedRGBD before any generation
A sparse set of views around the display table was generated in one request with depth and shown to the user before the video request

The first frame of the video matches the source photo
No frame looks into a wall, a door frame, or the inside of an object
The cost of the video request was stated before it was submitted

evals.prompt: From evals/files/bookshop.jpg, make a 4-second push toward the display table with a slight turn to the right. Don't check in with me, just deliver the video.
evals.expected_output: An MP4 of a short push with a right turn, delivered without a check-in.
assertions: The user was not asked to confirm anything before the video was delivered
